verses.en: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.pt: De novo veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

verses.en: Son of man, What is the vine tree more than any tree, or than a branch which is among the trees of the forest?
verses.pt: Filho do homem, que mais do que qualquer outro pau é o da videira, o sarmento que está entre as árvores do bosque?
verses.en_web: “Son of man, what is the vine tree more than any tree, the vine-branch which is among the trees of the forest?
verses.en_bbe: Son of man, what is the vine-tree more than any branching tree which is among the trees of the woods?

verses.en: Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work? or will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon?
verses.pt: Tema-se dele madeira para fazer alguma obra? ou toma-se dele alguma estaca, para se lhe pendurar algum traste?
verses.en_web: Will wood be taken of it to make anything? Will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel on it?
verses.en_bbe: Will its wood be used for any work? do men make of it a pin for hanging any vessel on?

verses.en: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire devoureth both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned. Is it meet for any work?
verses.pt: Eis que é lançado no fogo, para servir de pasto; o fogo devora ambas as suas extremidades, e o meio dele fica também queimado; serve para alguma obra?
verses.en_web: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire has devoured both its ends, and the middle of it is burned. Is it profitable for any work?
verses.en_bbe: See, it is put into the fire for burning: the fire has made a meal of its two ends and the middle part of it is burned; is it good for any work?

verses.en: Behold, when it was whole, it was meet for no work: how much less shall it be meet yet for any work, when the fire hath devoured it, and it is burned?
verses.pt: Ora, quando estava inteiro, não servia para obra alguma; quanto menos, estando consumido ou carbonizado pelo fogo, se faria dele qualquer obra?
verses.en_web: Behold, when it was whole, it was suitable for no work. How much less, when the fire has devoured it, and it has been burned, will it yet be suitable for any work?”
verses.en_bbe: Truly, before it was cut down, it was not used for any purpose: how much less, when the fire has made a meal of it and it is burned, will it be made into anything?

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.pt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor Deus: Como entre as árvores do bosque é o pau da videira, que entreguei para servir de pasto ao fogo, assim entregarei os habitantes de Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: “As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so I will give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause the Lord has said: Like the vine-tree among the trees of the woods which I have given to the fire for burning, so will I give the people of Jerusalem.

verses.en: And I will set my face against them; they shall go out from one fire, and another fire shall devour them; and ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I set my face against them.
verses.pt: E porei a minha face contra eles; eles sairão do fogo, mas o fogo os devorará; e sabereis que eu sou o Senhor, quando tiver posto a minha face contra eles.
verses.en_web: I will set my face against them. They will go out from the fire, but the fire will devour them. Then you will know that I am Yahweh, when I set my face against them.
verses.en_bbe: And my face will be turned against them; and though they have come out of the fire they will be burned up by it; and it will be clear to you that I am the Lord when my face is turned against them.

verses.en: And I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.pt: Farei da terra uma desolação, porquanto eles se houveram traiçoeiramente, diz o Senhor Deus.
verses.en_web: I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass,” says the Lord Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And I will make the land a waste because they have done evil, says the Lord.
